Team & Discipline Coordination Lead and manage a multidisciplinary team of architects and specialist consultant experts. Ensure all design inputs, deliverables, and package documentation are completed and submitted on schedule. Site & Construction Liaison Collaborate closely with the construction team to analyze site constraints and adapt design solutions accordingly. Bridge the gap between engineering design concepts and practical field execution. Reporting & Governance Maintain regular progress reporting directly to the Senior Engineering Manager for Engineering. Escalate critical issues, risks, and package conflicts to the client with clear resolution strategies. Profile/Skills Education: Bachelor’s degree in Architecture or equivalent field. Experience Solid background as a Senior Architect specializing in complex, high-public-usage buildings. Direct experience with railway stations or major transit infrastructure is strongly preferred. Proven Experience: 15-18 Years. Technical & Management Skills Proven capability to manage and coordinate within a multi-disciplinary environment . Drive customer engagement through value-based selling and consultative commercial approaches. Develop and execute strategic account plans for key customers and healthcare networks. Analyze market dynamics, competitor activity, healthcare funding trends and emerging opportunities to shape regional growth priorities. Monitor channel-partner performance through structured business reviews, KPI tracking and market feedback. Identify performance gaps within the channel network and recommend corrective actions, partner development plans or alternative partners when required to improve market coverage and business results. Build long-term relationships with turnkey providers to understand their project pipelines and influence solution design at an early stage. Ensure channel partners maintain the technical and commercial capabilities required to represent Radiometer effectively. Establish clear targets, performance indicators and accountability measures for distributor partners. Drive improved market coverage, opportunity development and customer support through the channel network. Stakeholder and Relationship Management Build trusted relationships with key healthcare decision-makers, influencers and clinical stakeholders. Represent Radiometer at industry events, conferences and relevant stakeholder forums. Act as a strategic advisor to customers by understanding their clinical, operational and financial challenges. Ensure clear internal communication and executive visibility throughout major strategic pursuits. Forecasting and Business Planning Develop accurate sales forecasts, annual business plans and well-qualified opportunity pipelines. Maintain strong pipeline discipline, including clear opportunity stages, values, timelines, risks and next actions. Manage budgets and resources effectively to optimize commercial performance. Deliver regular business reviews and performance reports to regional leadership. Track progress against sales, profitability, market-share and strategic project objectives. Ensure compliance with Danaher policies, industry regulations and ethical business practices. Required Qualifications Education Bachelor’s degree in Medical Technology, Biomedical Sciences, Life Sciences, Healthcare or a related discipline. A postgraduate qualification in Business Management or an MBA would be advantageous. Professional Experience At least seven years of successful commercial experience within medical diagnostics, medical devices or the broader healthcare industry. Demonstrated experience managing and developing business across African markets, particularly West Africa. Proven track record of delivering profitable sales growth and achieving commercial targets. Strong experience working with: Donor-funded healthcare programs International funding agencies Implementing partners NGOs Government healthcare institutions Ministries of Health Turnkey healthcare providers Experience leading large-scale healthcare projects, tenders or turnkey opportunities is highly desirable. Demonstrated experience managing distributors and indirect sales channels across multiple countries. Strong understanding of complex sales cycles, public procurement processes and stakeholder environments within African healthcare markets. Critical Competencies Commercial Excellence Strategic sales and territory planning Business development and market expansion Opportunity qualification and pipeline management Value-based and consultative selling Commercial negotiation and influencing Strategic-account development Distributor and channel-performance management Financial and commercial awareness Project and Stakeholder Management Funded-project identification and development Tender and proposal management Complex project-pursuit planning Cross-functional leadership Executive stakeholder engagement Customer and partner relationship management Contract negotiation and risk management Ability to navigate complex institutional environments Personal Attributes Results-oriented with a strong focus on execution. Strategic thinker capable of translating market insights into practical growth plans. Proactive, entrepreneurial and comfortable creating opportunities in developing markets. Highly organized, with strong planning and prioritization skills. Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities. Adaptable and resilient within complex and changing environments. Collaborative and able to influence stakeholders without direct authority. Strong sense of ownership, integrity and accountability. Culturally aware and effective in diverse, multinational environments. Language Requirements Fluent English, written and spoken. Fluent French, written and spoken—mandatory. Proficiency in additional African languages would be advantageous. Success Measures Success In This Role Will Be Assessed Through Achievement of annual sales, profitability and margin targets. Growth of Radiometer’s market share across West Africa. Value and quality of funded and turnkey projects secured across Africa. Strength and maturity of Radiometer’s strategic relationships with turnkey providers. Early access to major healthcare infrastructure projects and repeat inclusion in strategic opportunities. Expansion, capability and performance of the distributor and channel-partner network. Customer satisfaction, retention and long-term account development. Forecast accuracy and quality of the commercial opportunity pipeline. Successful execution of strategic healthcare projects. Compliance with Radiometer and Danaher policies and ethical business standards. Ideal Candidate Profile We are looking for a commercially driven healthcare professional who has successfully developed business across African healthcare markets and understands the donor-funded healthcare ecosystem. The ideal candidate will bring a strong network across Ministries of Health, funding organizations, implementing partners, government institutions and turnkey providers. They will combine strategic business-development expertise with the commercial discipline and stakeholder-management capabilities required to convert large, complex opportunities into sustainable growth. This is an excellent opportunity for an entrepreneurial commercial leader who wants to shape Radiometer’s growth across West Africa while contributing to transformative healthcare projects throughout Africa. Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life. For more information, visit www.danaher.com.

You will act as the client's technical authority, bridging the gap between design intent and field execution—verifying that shop drawings align with specifications and that on-site construction work is executed correctly, safely, and efficiently, particularly within the demanding environment of rail and transit projects. Main Duties & Responsibilities The Day-to-day And Project-based Tasks Design Review & Compliance: Lead the technical review of mechanical designs (HVAC, plumbing, fire protection) developed by internal teams or external consultants. Rail & Transit Specialization: Apply deep domain expertise to oversee mechanical systems for rail projects, addressing unique challenges such as ventilation for tunnels and below-grade stations, smoke extraction systems, platform pressurization, and the specific environmental control needs of rail operations and equipment rooms. Construction Support & Issue Resolution: Serve as the primary mechanical point of contact during construction. Review and respond to Requests for Information (RFIs) and troubleshoot complex field issues, providing practical solutions that maintain design integrity without delaying project timelines. Technical Leadership: Serve as the technical authority on mechanical engineering, resolving complex engineering challenges and performing peer reviews of design calculations, drawings, and specifications. Client & Stakeholder Communication: Attend client meetings to present mechanical designs, explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders, and manage client expectations regarding system performance and cost. Profile/Skills ducation: Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering (master’s degree preferred). Licensure: Professional Engineer (PE) license is required. Experience: 8-10 years of progressive experience in MEP consulting engineering or a design-build firm, specifically focused on building systems. Rail Experience: Demonstrated and significant experience working on rail or transit projects (e.g., commuter rail, light rail, subway, or high-speed rail stations and facilities). Systra is an equal opportunities company; this position is open to all applicants. Workplace Type On-site
